card.what: The J/22's mainsheet traveler: a 22 mm high-beam track spanning the cockpit seat to seat, its end stops, a 73 mm ball-bearing car with a pivoting shackle and control tangs, and a 2:1 control line each side to a cam cleat
card.boats: J/22 hero (Inputs/j22-hero/j22_mainsheet.py, part of SM_J22H_Hull). The light J/22 (Tools/blender/build_j22.py) keeps its own simple track
card.distance: the helm camera sees it every second; the crew's legs cross it
card.before: j22_mainsheet.traveler (Oct 2026, Bean's feedback 1): a 32 mm T-section track, a flat box car with two sideways sheaves, black end caps with a sheave, blue control lines to separate cam cleats on the seats

features.text: One track from seat to seat, let into each seat and bridging the well with no support under it
High-beam section: a 22 mm head with ball races under its edges on a deeper stem and foot
The crew's white index marks and numbers on the track over the well
Flat-head screws along the track where it lies on the seats
A black square end stop over each end of the track, two screws on top
A small black car wrapping the track's head, with moulded end caps
A pivoting shackle base on the car under the lower block's swivel
A control tang at each end of the car with a small block on it
2:1 control each side: dead end on an eye strap, in to the car's block and back out to a cam cleat on a swivel base
Yellow control line (black flecks in the photo; flat yellow in the game's hull material)

budget.note: an assembly: track, car, two blocks, two cam cleats, lines; the hull's whole cap is 1.2M
